title: The inertias of ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L and the check of all models
author: Claude-JG
description: The masses and inertias of the model are estimates. To be taken from a URDF with inertias or estimated by the inertia workflow; all models checked for physical inertias.
releaseNotes: The masses, centers of mass and inertias of ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L are those of the solids of the visual meshes with one density, adjusted to the 117 kg of the manufacturer including the base.
